premises.text: Knowledge is siloed in enterprises, leading to repeated work and mistakes.
premises.evidence_span: the root cause of this was simply because all the knowledge was siloed.

premises.text: A collaborative Q&A platform can help employees find answers to their questions.
premises.evidence_span: So we take the power of a Q&A site, meld it with the flexibility of wikis to create a really organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise.

premises.text: Integrating with email can enhance the usability of the Q&A platform.
premises.evidence_span: we allow people to ask questions directly by email, answer them directly by replying to an email.

premises.text: Anonymity in questions can encourage employees to ask important but potentially embarrassing questions.
premises.evidence_span: this is different from the consumer side, anonymity, because in the enterprise context, certainly there is already an implicit amount of trust within people.

premises.text: A powerful search engine is necessary for users to find previous answers efficiently.
premises.evidence_span: we have a very fast, very powerful search engine that allows people to find previous answers to questions that they have already.

premises.text: The platform can be adapted for various use cases across different industries.
premises.evidence_span: You can use it and deploy it within a sales force or a large customer service team to document the little fires that come out over and over again.

value.text: Companies can share knowledge effectively through a collaborative platform.
value.evidence_span: Opsy's mission is to help people at companies share knowledge.
